title: Replace NsAppShell drawer with NsNavSidebar
description:
## Context

`NsAppShell` currently uses `NsDrawer` (a wrapper around Quasar's `QDrawer`) for its side navigation, with material-icon-string-keyed items, route-based selection (`to` URL + `active` flag), separators, and slot-based extension points.

`NsNavSidebar` (added recently, PR #118) is a custom non-Quasar sidebar with id-based selection, Vue-component icons, flyout sub-menus, a bottom item slot, and the animated-eye toggle.

We want one sidebar primitive in the library, and the animated NsNavSidebar should be the one. `NsAppShell` should consume it for its side nav.

## Goal

Replace the `NsDrawer`-based sidebar inside `NsAppShell` with `NsNavSidebar`, so that consumers of `NsAppShell` automatically get the new sidebar (left-aligned items, animated eye toggle, flyout sub-menus). Maintain `NsAppShell`'s responsive behavior (mobile hamburger, tablet mini-rail, desktop persistent).

## Why this is a bead, not a one-line swap

The two components currently differ in shape:

| Feature | NsAppShell drawer (today) | NsNavSidebar (today) |
|---|---|---|
| Underlying primitive | `NsDrawer` / Quasar `QDrawer` | Custom flex layout |
| Responsive behavior | Auto mini-rail at `md`, hamburger on mobile, persistent at desktop | None |
| Icon type | Material-icon **string** via `NsIcon` | Vue `Component` |
| Item selection | Route `to` URL + `active` flag | ID-based, emits `update:modelValue` |
| Item structure | Recursive `children` array | One level `sub: string[]` (flyout) |
| Separators | `item.separator` boolean | Not supported |
| Drawer slots | `drawer-header`, `drawer-footer` | None |

## Scope (in)

1. Add the missing primitives to `NsNavSidebar`:
   - `separator: boolean` on `NsNavItem`
   - `active: boolean` override (in addition to the id-derived active state)
   - `to?: string` on `NsNavItem` for routing — when present, the pill renders as a `<router-link>` (or `<a href="...">` as fallback), and clicking emits both `update:modelValue` and follows the link
2. Bridge material-icon strings to Vue components:
   - Either (a) accept `string | Component` for `NsNavItem.icon` and wrap strings in `NsIcon` internally, or (b) require callers to pre-wrap. Decide as part of this work.
3. Decide who owns responsive behavior:
   - Option A: `NsAppShell` continues to wrap `NsNavSidebar` in `NsDrawer` (keeps existing breakpoint logic, drops one layer of redundancy)
   - Option B: Move responsive behavior into `NsNavSidebar` itself
   - Recommendation: Option A — keeps `NsNavSidebar` simple and reusable outside `NsAppShell`
4. Map `NsAppShellNavItem` → `NsNavItem` inside `NsAppShell` (rename `name` → `id`, etc.), keeping `NsAppShell`'s public API unchanged
5. Preserve `NsAppShell`'s `drawer-header` and `drawer-footer` slots — expose equivalent slots on `NsNavSidebar` or accept them at the `NsAppShell` wrapper level
6. Migrate `NsAppShell` tests and stories that depend on the old drawer structure
7. Update `NsNavSidebar` stories to demonstrate the new fields (`separator`, `to`, `active`)

## Scope (out)

- No public API change to `NsAppShell` — consumers of `NsAppShellNavItem` should not need to update their data shape
- No new responsive behavior on `NsNavSidebar` standalone (Option A above)
- No removal of `NsDrawer` from the library — it's used elsewhere

## Open questions

- **Children / recursive nav:** `NsAppShellNavItem.children` is recursive (multi-level). `NsNavSidebar.sub` is one level (flyout). Do any real consumers use multi-level nav? If not, flatten to one level. If yes, this scope grows.
- **Route integration:** Library is router-agnostic today. Adding `to` either pulls in Vue Router as a peer dep or we render plain `<a href>` and let consumers attach their own router behavior on click. Recommend the second option.
- **Icon type:** Accepting `string | Component` adds a small union to handle. Worth it for backward compat with `NsAppShellNavItem.icon: string`.

## Dependencies

- Blocked on: nothing (PR #118 animated-eye landed)
- Related: any in-flight `NsAppShell` work — coordinate to avoid conflicts on `NsAppShell.vue`

## Rough size

~3 sub-tasks: (1) extend `NsNavSidebar` types + features, (2) swap inside `NsAppShell` + map types, (3) tests + stories migration. Half-day each, ~1.5 days total. Could grow if multi-level nav turns out to be in-use.
acceptance_criteria:
- NsAppShell renders its side nav via NsNavSidebar on desktop
- Responsive behavior unchanged: mobile drawer toggles via hamburger; tablet shows mini-rail; desktop shows full sidebar
- NsAppShellNavItem's separator, active, to, children, and material-icon icon all continue to work
- Animated eye toggle visible on desktop (replaces the old "Hide Menu" chevron item)
- All existing NsAppShell tests pass without modification to their public assertions
- NsAppShell stories render correctly in both light and dark modes, at all three breakpoints
- NsNavSidebar exports the new separator, active, to fields and documents them in its types
- pnpm test && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint && pnpm build all pass
- No visual regression in the existing NsAppShell "Dashboard" / "Items" demo stories (eyeball + screenshot check)

title: Fix Playwright browser setup for Storybook interaction tests
description: Storybook interaction tests fail because Playwright browsers are not installed. The vitest config has a 'storybook' test project using @vitest/browser-playwright, but tests error with 'browserType.launch: Executable does not exist'. Options: (1) add 'pnpm exec playwright install' to setup/CI workflow, or (2) make the storybook test project optional so unit tests are not blocked by missing browsers.
close_reason: Fixed — scoped test scripts to unit project, added test:storybook script, updated CI. PR #50.

title: Migrate deprecated Vite formats option to rollupOptions output
description: Vite 8 deprecated build.lib.formats in favor of rollupOptions.output.format. Current vite.config.ts uses formats: ['es'] which still works but may produce warnings in future versions. Migrate to the new API.
close_reason: Removed unused UMD globals from vite config, cleaned up beads gitignore. PR #45.
